title: Brazil's President Lula has skin lesion removed
text: Brazilian President Luiz ​Inacio Lula da ‌Silva underwent a successful procedure to remove ​a skin lesion ​at a Sao Paulo ⁠hospital on ​Friday and is expected ​to resume normal activities in the coming days, ​his doctor ​Roberto Kalil Filho said.

title: Russia vows to help Cuba withstand US 'blackmail and threats'
text: Russia said on Friday that it stood in solidarity with ​Cuba and would continue to provide humanitarian aid to the Communist‑run ‌island republic, rejecting what it described as blackmail and threats from Washington.

title: Brazil shackles public pension funds after Banco Master meltdown
text: Brazil's biggest bank failure in recent history has led to an aggressive crackdown on public pension funds, which were ​among its creditors, limiting their portfolios in ways that could make it harder to hit their long-term targets.

title: No briefings, no buzz: Senegal's Washington trip leaves investors uneasy
text: Senegal's talks with the International Monetary Fund at the Spring Meetings in Washington last week were touted ​as the next step for debt-distressed Dakar's efforts to clinch a new loan programme.

title: Dollar holds weekly gains as war uncertainty keeps markets on edge
text: The dollar dipped on Friday but remained on pace ​for a weekly gain as traders continued to assess the prospects for a resolution to the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran. The currency has ‌been buoyed at times by optimism that a near-term deal could end the conflict, then weighed down by fears that a prolonged war will trigger lasting energy disruptions.

title: South African rand edges up as investors track US-Iran talks, await local month-end data
text: The South African rand edged up on Friday, as signs emerged of possible peace talks between the U.S. ​and Iran that could ease Middle East tensions, while domestically focussed traders ‌looked ahead to month-end data for clues on the health of Africa's largest economy.

title: China bans dual-use item exports to seven European entities over Taiwan arms sales
text: China's Commerce Ministry said on Friday it ​was banning exports of dual-use items to seven European entities over arms sales to Taiwan, placing them ‌immediately on its export control list, in a rare case of Europe-targeted, Taiwan-related sanctions.

title: More than 100 holidaymakers struck by killer virus that makes body ‘fold in on itself’ in tourist spot – 8 signs to know
text: HOLIDAYMAKERS in the Caribbean have been hit by a surge in tropical virus infections that can make the body fold in on itself. Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne disease that causes crippling joint pain and and can leaves some victims riddled with deformities.

title: The 60p supplement you’ve never heard of that fuels weight loss – and turbocharges fat jabs
text: WEIGHT loss jabs have taken the UK by storm and they can be incredibly effective for some, causing them to lose up to 20 per cent of their body weight. Others may be left deflated staring at scale numbers that refuse to go down. But a cheap supplement – dubbed ‘the poor man’s Ozempic’ because it costs as little as 60p – could form a potent combination with the jabs, helping to turbocharge weight loss.

title: Target eyes opening of sprawling new ‘anchor’ store in mall space – but there are concerns it’ll be too popular
text: One of the first issues that SimonCRE, the developer behind the project, faced was pushback on proposed zoning changes. To build the 128,660-square-foot Target, Simon CRE proposed changes to the town’s zoning regulations necessary for a building that large. But Gilbert’s Town Council has received calls from countless Arizona residents to keep the zoning the same. The Target proposal was first announced last May and drew more than 200 residents to a neighborhood meeting, most of whom opposed it.

title: All Texas Roadhouse locations brace for new 50cent policy under July ‘hourly’ law
text: TEXAS Roadhouse as well as other major restaurants and retailers in one US state are all bracing for a new 50-cent bump law to take effect in July. When the legislation is implemented this summer, it will force all entry-level employers in the state to raise the minimum wage by half a dollar.

title: Dramatic moment Ukrainian officer hacks presentation to Russian would-be recruits – & warns: ‘I’ll have to kill you all’
text: THIS is the astonishing moment a Ukrainian soldier successfully infiltrates a Russian university to warn students they face certain death if they go to war. The masked man appears via video link, posing as a Russian fighter to conceal his true identity.

title: Woman trapped waist-deep in poo for THREE HOURS after toilet collapses in remote Australian outback
text: A WOMAN on a road trip has taken an unexpected detour after she became trapped waist deep in poo for three hours when an outdoor loo collapsed. She had been travelling through the Australian outback with her husband and two children when they stopped to use the pit toilet – a hole in the ground beneath a toilet bowl.

title: Healthy British mum dies at Swiss suicide clinic aged 56 after choosing to end her own life over grief at losing son
text: A BRITISH mum who was left too distraught to live after her son died in a tragic accident has taken her own life in Switzerland. Former care worker Wendy Duffy, 56, who was physically healthy, travelled from the West Midlands to the controversial Pegasos clinic yesterday.
